title: Ezra's Journey from Babylon to Jerusalem
description:
Ezra, a scribe priest descended from the high priest Aaron, travels up from Babylon to Jerusalem in the seventh year of King Artaxerxes' reign.  
The king grants him everything he asks for, because the hand of the Lord is upon him.  
Together with Israelites, priests, Levites, singers, gatekeepers and temple servants, he begins his journey on the first day of the first month and arrives in Jerusalem on the first day of the fifth month.  
Ezra has set his heart to study the law of the Lord, to live by it and to teach Israel its statutes and ordinances.
